evidence.notes: System.Metadata is the documented namespace-qualified alias for the deterministic Metadata base DTO; the local constructor yields a Metadata object.
clone() runs through the generic Metadata DTO clone path and preserves fullName.
fullName is a mutable deterministic field on the System-qualified Metadata alias.

source.content: @isTest private class SystemMetadataAliasDeterministicTest { @isTest static void systemMetadataAliasCompilesAndRuns() { System.Metadata metadata = new System.Metadata(); metadata.fullName = 'Feature.Default'; System.Metadata cloned = (System.Metadata)metadata.clone(); System.assertEquals('Feature.Default', cloned.fullName); System.assertEquals('Feature.Default', metadata.fullName); } }
